hints.title: Age Bucket Aggregation
hints.text: Group individuals by age to compute the number of qualifying peer targets in constant time.

hints.title: Friend Request Constraints
hints.text: Person x can request person y if and only if 0.5 * age[x] + 7 < age[y] <= age[x].

hints.title: Prefix Sum Count Query
hints.text: Build prefix sums over age counts from 1 to 120. For each valid age x >= 15, query the count of valid y values in the open-closed interval and multiply by count[x].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Frequency bucket counting with prefix sum interval queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs evaluation takes O(N^2) time which times out for N = 20000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(120) for age counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploit bounded age domain 1..120 to achieve linear O(N) performance.
